name: IT services and internal IT teams
description: Software/IT companies and internal IT departments evaluating AI for their own workflows.

typical_workflows.name: Support ticket triage
typical_workflows.description: Read incoming tickets, categorize, set priority, route to a team.

typical_workflows.name: Code review
typical_workflows.description: Review pull requests for bugs, style and security issues.

typical_workflows.name: Documentation
typical_workflows.description: Write and update technical docs, runbooks and release notes.

typical_workflows.name: Incident summaries
typical_workflows.description: Turn alerts, chat logs and timelines into post-incident reports.

typical_workflows.name: RFP and proposal responses
typical_workflows.description: Answer questionnaires and draft proposals using past answers.

compliance_notes: Source code and customer tickets may contain secrets, credentials or customer personal data; check what is sent to an outside AI provider.
Client contracts may forbid sharing their data or code with third-party AI services.
RFP answers may contain confidential pricing or client names.
follow_up_questions: Roughly how many tickets, pull requests or documents do you handle per month?
Do tickets or code contain customer data or credentials?
Which ticketing and code tools do you use, and do they have an API?
Do you already have a library of past answers or documentation to draw on?
